summary: OddOneGaming showcases a Corrosion team that achieves over 1.1 billion damage against the Mekkatorque boss. Although Corrosion typically excels against multi-target encounters, a high-inspiration Rook performs exceptionally well in this single-target fight. Rook is built with 100% Crit Rate, max Crit Damage, high Resistance, and a 1-piece Steam Sonata gear piece to maximize Skill Haste from ultimate casts. The supporting lineup of Sacredeia, Twitch, Reytah, and Child of Chaos provides debuffs, supplementary damage, and crucial cleanses.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.note: Deals massive true damage through Corrosion consumption; build with 100% Crit Rate, max Crit Damage, high Resistance, and 1-piece Steam Sonata for bonus Skill Haste.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Build for full damage while ensuring enough Accuracy to consistently land her debuffs.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Built for full damage equipped with the Swamp Toadstool artifact to boost Corrosion output.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.note: Provides cleansing and sustain; geared with Mystic Conch and bonus Skill Haste.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Provides additional cleanses and debuffs using Whirling Doom; stack Attack and survivability.

teams.note: Reached 1.13 billion damage against Lv. 260 Mekkatorque using full Corrosion synergy and high Resistance to resist boss debuffs.

tips: Equip Rook with 1 piece of Steam Sonata (gloves or chest) to gain up to 40 Skill Haste permanently as he cycles ultimates.
Stack high Resistance on Rook to prevent recharge speed penalties and boss debuffs from cutting into his DPS.
Ensure Sacredeia has enough Accuracy to apply her debuffs even when building her for pure damage.
If RNG on cleanse timings from Reytah or Child of Chaos fails to hit 1B damage, rerun the combat simulation.
title: 🚨 This Team BLEW MY MIND🚨 Corrosion vs Mekkatorque Boss S8 Boss | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
